Cabinet approves river interlinking project for Bihar

Posted On: 28 SEP 2026 6:00PM by PIB Patna

The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs today approved the interlinking of two river basins in Bihar at an estimated cost of Rs 4,800 crore.

The project envisages transfer of surplus monsoon flows to water-deficit districts of south Bihar, covering irrigation for nearly two lakh hectares.

According to an official release, the central assistance component will be 60 per cent of the project cost, with the balance borne by the state.

The release added that environmental clearance has been obtained and land acquisition is at an advanced stage in three districts.

Implementation will be overseen by a special purpose vehicle with representatives from the Centre and the state, the release said.
